processors.name: start upload
processors.comments: Bodyless POST, answers 202 with a Location header. Works on every registry

processors.name: skip existing
processors.comments: Intentional drop of a duplicate blob: the destination already has it

processors.name: put blob
processors.comments: Sends the blob as the body and answers 201. One concurrent task

processors.name: target settings
processors.comments: RouteOnAttribute and expression literals do not resolve parameters, so they are copied to attributes first

processors.name: head blob
processors.comments: 200 means the destination already has the blob

processors.name: manifest gate
processors.comments: Waits up to 25 s for every blob it names, then PUTs the manifest bytes unchanged

processors.name: hold
processors.comments: Stopped on purpose: failed FlowFiles wait here with their content

processors.name: scrub
processors.comments: Deletes the token before a FlowFile waits in hold

processors.name: dst expire token
processors.comments: A 401 means the token expired or was revoked: force a new mint on the retry

processors.name: upload url
processors.comments: Location may be relative or absolute, with or without a query, and HTTP/2 lower-cases the header name; digest is appended

processors.name: target repository
processors.comments: Empty dst_repository keeps the source repository name; otherwise every image goes to dst_repository

processors.name: dst token check
processors.comments: true when this FlowFile still holds a token for this repository and scope that has not expired

processors.name: upload url ok
processors.comments: Credentials are only sent to dst_url: a Location on another host goes to hold
